sources.notes: jkb.bank.in (and the legacy jkbank.com) cannot be reached from this sandbox at all: a direct fetch times out (curl, 45s, no response) and a real headless browser gets a network-level chrome-error://chromewebdata/ on the same URL, so this is a connectivity failure, not a captcha/WAF block -- robots.txt itself could not be fetched either, so robotsAllowed is left unset rather than guessed. Per the project's rule for unreachable pages, the fixture is a genuine copy from the Internet Archive's unmodified snapshot (https://web.archive.org/web/20260415043804id_/https://jkb.bank.in/interest-rates, captured 2026-04-15) instead of a live fetch or browser capture -- so this fixture, and the rates read from it, are already about 5.5 months stale relative to today by the nature of being an archived copy of a page this sandbox cannot reach. GitHub Actions or a VPS on a different network path may reach the live page and get current rates. Covers the domestic/NRO/NRE retail ladder below Rs 3 crore plus a single-tenure (888 days) non-callable Rs 1-3 crore tier that sits on the same page with its own, earlier 'w.e.f' date. Senior citizen (+0.50%), super senior (+0.25% further) and staff (+1%) premiums are stated only as additive text, never as their own numeric column, so no senior/super-senior/staff RateRow is produced -- recorded in `terms` instead. No RD source: no recurring-deposit table or FD-rate-parity statement is on this page or findable elsewhere on the site this session -- RD rates are not published on the official site.

Same unreachable-from-this-sandbox / Internet Archive id_ snapshot situation as jk-bank:fd (see its notes) -- fixture captured 2026-04-15. Covers only the Rs 3cr-<5cr tier, both the 'Withdrawable' (callable) and 'Non-Withdrawable' (non-callable) tables that are inline HTML on this same page. Bulk tiers >=Rs 5 crore are NOT an inline table on this page -- the 'Bulk Deposit Rates Callable & Non Callable' section is only a 'Click here to download' link to https://eapp.jkbank.com/eintraweb/domestic-rates, an internal-looking host ('eapp'/'intraweb') that looks like an employee intranet system, not a page any client here could fetch -- a genuine gap, not a guess.

Same unreachable-from-this-sandbox / Internet Archive id_ snapshot situation as jk-bank:fd (see its notes) -- fixture captured 2026-04-15. Flat rate (2.55% in that snapshot) across all balances, no slabs; staff get a separate 3.50% not included here.

robots.txt checked (Drupal default; /deposit-data and /savings-account-interest-rates are not under any Disallow path). Verified against a live fetch on 2026-09-27 (28 rows: general + senior callable below Rs 3cr, plus the non-callable Rs 2cr-<3cr band that sits on the same page, included here like SBI's Rs 1cr+ non-callable band). No RD source: re-checked live on 2026-09-27 at https://www.karnatakabank.bank.in/personal/term-deposits/recurring-deposit -- zero <table> elements, and the page's only statement on rate parity is marketing copy ('RDs offer interest rates similar to FDs' / 'similar to that of fixed deposits'), not the bank stating the rates ARE equal, so RD rates are not published on the official site rather than derived.

robots.txt checked: 'User-agent: *' with no Disallow lines at all. A plain fetch of this URL returns HTTP 200 but the rate tables are empty shells filled in by client-side JS (confirmed again on 2026-09-27, 0 <table> elements in the raw HTML) -- format is 'browser' because of that JS rendering, not a captcha/WAF (Incapsula's bot-check script tag is present on the page but did not block a plain fetch of the shell HTML itself). A real headless browser renders the tables; verified against a live browser fetch on 2026-09-27. Separately discovered (but NOT switched to, kept as a note for a future pass): this page's own script (assets/javascript/nro-deposit-rates.js) calls a plain, unauthenticated public JSON endpoint (https://www.kvb.bank.in/manager/api/v1/nro-deposit-rates?request_for[]=domestic_term_interest_rates&request_for[]=senior_citizen_interest_rates&request_for[]=flexi_term_interest_rates) that returns the exact same figures without needing a browser at all -- a more robust 'format: json' adapter could be built directly against it later. That same JSON also carries a 'flexi_term_interest_rates' table (a single '300 days' / 3.25% row) that is requested by this page's own JS but was not present in the rendered DOM when the fixture was captured -- a known gap, not a guess. RD: derived from the FD card via `deriveRdFromFd` because KVB's own 'Policy on Deposits' PDF states RD rates equal the FD card rate for the same tenure with no differential pricing by instalment amount (quoted in the adapter's notes). Residency: the page's own, server-rendered <h1>title 'Resident / NRO Deposits' (present before the JS-filled tables even load) is the bank's own statement that the one published general-public rate column applies to Resident AND NRO alike, so general-public (and Green Deposits) rows are produced twice, once per residency, from that one number -- not two independently-sourced figures. The senior-citizen table is excluded from this (its own text: 'Senior Citizen rates are not applicable to NRI'), so senior rows stay Resident only. 'For KVB - Tax Shield Deposits' and 'Rainbow Deposits (RBFD)' are listed in the same table without a tenure band of their own, so they are not included as rows.

sources.notes: Same client-rendered-JS situation as karur-vysya-bank:fd (see its notes; format 'browser' for the same reason, not a captcha/WAF). Verified against a live browser fetch on 2026-09-27; six amount tiers (Rs 2cr-<5cr through Rs 100cr+ -- the tier the page LABELS 'Rs. 3 Cr. to < Rs. 5 Cr.' in its rendered header uses the internal field name 'rupees_2_to_5_crore' in this page's own JSON API, a legacy naming mismatch on the bank's side; the rendered label is what is used here), each with a premature-withdrawal-allowed and a not-allowed rate. This page's own 'effective from' date is filled in to the day it is loaded (bulk/Treasury rates are set daily per KVB's policy), so it will normally equal the day the collector runs -- confirmed live on 2026-09-27, the page read exactly that day's date. Same plain public JSON endpoint discovery as the fd source above applies here too (https://www.kvb.bank.in/manager/api/v1/bulk-deposit-rates) -- not switched to for this pass.

Same client-rendered-JS situation as karur-vysya-bank:fd (see its notes). Verified against a live browser fetch on 2026-09-27; nine EOD-balance slabs. The page does not state whether slabs are whole-balance or incremental, so slabMethod is 'unknown'. Same plain public JSON endpoint discovery applies here too (https://www.kvb.bank.in/manager/api/v1/savings-interest-rates) -- not switched to for this pass.

robots.txt checked: allows crawlers generally, and explicitly allows GPTBot/ClaudeBot/PerplexityBot/bingbot by name; /en/rates/interest-rates.html is not under any Disallow path. kotak.com redirects to kotak.bank.in (confirmed live via browser navigation on 2026-09-27) -- kotak.bank.in is the canonical URL registered here. Both domains return HTTP 403 to a plain fetch from this sandbox with a Cloudflare bot-management challenge cookie (__cf_bm) even though robots.txt allows it, so format is 'browser'; a real headless browser is NOT blocked. Re-verified live on 2026-09-27: the page's own 'Fixed Deposits Interest Rates for Domestic/ NRO / NRE effective from 23rd Sep 2026' caption and the 7-14 day retail rate cells (2.75% general / 3.25% senior) are byte-for-byte identical to the tested fixture -- no rate drift. One page also carries the bulk, RD and savings tables used by the other kotak-mahindra-bank.* adapters below.
